authority: Human asks known-text/numeral positive and null controls; vault closed and v7.2 unchanged
scope: Adapter control qualification only; no real B/C claim, marker selection, C1 historical audit, or reserved dataset access

known_text.source: Existing Macer development-only source; no new claim about a historical ordered name list
known_text.units: Two distinct prefix-free two-letter cipher alphabets with identical known Latin values; initial-position identity rules on first alphabet create declared role structure
known_text.pair_spans: 24 unique nonoverlapping three-word phrases from held source chapters; distinct records/slots, no identity self-pair
known_text.train: First half of chapter units, for fake-list token pools only; known cipher key is fixed independently of text
known_text.held: Second half of chapter units; no map fit
known_text.noise: whole source-word erasure independently by reading/side; H=.10 F=.20 declared stress envelope, not an observed manuscript noise estimate
known_text.positive: True known-text pairs, both independent encodings
nulls: independent shuffled partner labels, same label multisets
source-first within-span word shuffle independently each side
source-first within-word internal glyph shuffle independently each side
same-length fake pairs from training word pool
known_text.banks: 1000 unchanged harness.random_key and 1000 unchanged v7.2 random_role_key; separate seeds; fixed single control panel, plus 200 fresh wrong proposals from EACH bank
known_text.decisions: Exact E2 span match fraction; Monte Carlo upper-tail p with +1 correction. Paired-text detection p<=.01 against each frozen null family; correct key must also exceed BOTH random-key banks on fixed panel. This is not a full v7 verdict or E1-E6 coherence qualification.

numerals_and_order.source: synthetic figure IDs on a permitted open-page identifier; no real label text or geometry read
numerals_and_order.templates: fixed exact sequence 1..N and independent known-text phrase sequence; every per-band rotation/direction and band order charged, including aliases
numerals_and_order.numerals: Fixed two-letter digit codes, exact Fraction comparisons, including multi-digit values; no learned number assignment or rounding
numerals_and_order.noise: H=.10 F=.20 label erasure; paired but separately scored, dependent alternate readings
numerals_and_order.positive: Generate source at one randomly selected legal geometry alignment, then independently corrupt readings
nulls: layout-only regular phase/category covariate with independent random labels
wrong-unit cyclic templates with incompatible inventory
numerals_and_order.search: Observed and every null maximize identical full alignment space; no truncation. Precompile adapter alignment IDs then vectorize exact same integer match sum, with exhaustive reference checks before outcomes.
numerals_and_order.decisions: Per-route p<=.01 vs 1000 within-band permutations; every outer trial independently regenerates data and null. No resampling failed trials.

gates.positive: At least 0.80 detection in 200 trials for each H/F cell; also report Wilson bounds
gates.negative: At most .05 empirical flag rate AND Wilson 95 upper <=.05 in each 200-trial null cell
gates.wrong_key: At least .99 fail AND exact one-sided 95 CP upper PASS <=.03 per 200 fresh-proposal bank
gates.integrity: Full baseline tree hash equality; original adapter hash equality; fast/reference equality; read allowlist audit; vault remains closed

failures: Keep every failed cell. No change to plan, scorer, seeds, noise or thresholds after outcomes. A failed cell limits qualification; repairs require separate attempt.
not_qualified_here: real reserved geometry and observed H/F noise
B N1-N4 candidate selection and candidate-specific power
historical C list/variant/arm search and fake-list fitted-key trap at maximum complexity
